settlement_loop correctness hardening (pre-wiring keystone) — review-team-3 cluster
description: review-team-3 (w96w45naz) confirmed 5 defects in hermes_quant/daemon/settlement_loop.py, the BMA-Beta-auto-learning keystone (ADR-0083). All LATENT (no production caller — daemon/main.py uses construct_realized_outcomes/dispatch_settlement, not join_exit_fills), not Monday-blocking, but must be correct BEFORE wiring into dispatch. (1) HIGH: join_exit_fills reads synthetic schema (rec['side']/['qty']/['asof']) incompatible with the real bus from PaperReactor._record_to_dict (asof_decision/asof_execution, target_position_pct/fill_size_pct, NO side/qty/exec_id) — a real entry+exit pair settles to ([],{}); docstring 'reads the SAME records' is false. Fix: bus->lot adapter (side from sign of target_position_pct/fill_size_pct delta, qty from |delta|, asof from asof_execution); correct docstring; real-_record_to_dict-shaped test. (2) MED: same-asof entry/exit matched in reverse (exec_id lexical tie-break) inverts side+magnitude. Fix: tie-break by positional bus index/proposal lineage, opening before closing. (3) MED: out-of-order carry-in opens a phantom opposing lot, violating one-direction-per-queue. Fix: defer the exit on the lot.asof>asof break instead of opening a residual lot; assert invariant. (4) LOW: mixed tz-aware/naive asof across carry-in raises TypeError; normalize to UTC in _coerce_asof. (5) LOW: compute_horizon_return fee (fees/ep) diverges from join_exit_fills (fees/(ep*qty)) for qty!=1; add qty param. Each fix->adversarial-verify, offline-deterministic, additive (keystone stays unwired), asof-honest.

title: play_loader fail-closed validation — review-team-3 cluster (MED+LOW)
description: review-team-3 confirmed play_loader.py does NOT fail-closed, contradicting its rail 'one bad external play never crashes registry build'. Both LATENT (HERMES_QUANT_PLAYS_OPEN default-OFF AND install_external_plays has no production caller). (1) MED: play_profile_from_mapping validates name/bias/keys but NOT rule tuples. A valid-looking external play with a bad rule (unknown op/wrong arity) LOADS, then score_all() RAISES for ALL plays (iterates every play); via score_symbol's blanket except->0.0 every built-in scores 0.0 and evolve_watchlist (0.0<evict_floor 0.45) mass-evicts the watchlist. Fix: validate each rule op against scorers' op-set + arity in play_profile_from_mapping; skip+log at LOAD. (2) LOW: regime_gates action values unvalidated — {bull:nuke} loads, _eval_regime_gate treats unknown as allow (fails OPEN). Fix: validate against {allow,warn,deny}; skip+log on unknown. Each fix->adversarial-verify, default-OFF byte-identical (built-in 5 unchanged), offline tests proving malformed play rejected at load.

title: options_gate O8 require explicit decision_asof in replay (review-team-3 LOW)
description: review-team-3 confirmed _earnings_proximity_violation (options_gate.py:412) falls back to datetime.now(UTC) when decision_asof is None, options_gate passes it through defaulting None. A replay caller forgetting decision_asof measures the forward earnings window vs wall-clock now, MISSING imminent-earnings rejects in past-dated replay (under-blocks; never leaks). LATENT: no committed caller passes event_risk to options_gate. Equity path (in_event_blackout) already requires asof. Fix: when event_risk supplied, require explicit decision_asof (raise/abstain not silently now()); no-event_risk path byte-identical. Offline test: replay with event_risk but no decision_asof fails-closed.
